title: CATL and Tencent back Deepseek's ballooning funding round as the AI startup eyes a 2027 IPO
text:
Deepseek is close to raising at least $12 billion in a new funding round, Bloomberg reports.
The article CATL and Tencent back Deepseek's ballooning funding round as the AI startup eyes a 2027 IPO appeared first on The Decoder.
